fit_reason: Whole boat, a cruiser listed by a private seller, which we can detail.
findings: Gelcoat on the hull, deck and transom looks bright and glossy overall, with no visible chalking
Light grayish soiling on the white vinyl of the transom bench and cockpit seat cushions
Loose gear (straps, a bowl, a bottle) visible in the clear dash storage hatch by the windshield
Light water spotting on the windshield glass
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Rinker 320 EX and it looks well kept. The white vinyl on the transom and cockpit seats is showing a little gray soiling, and a cleanup there plus a wash and wax would help it pop in photos and showings. We do pre-sale boat details right at the slip. Would you like a quote?
